name: GoliathOmics
tagline: Configurable genomics and multi-omics workflows: from raw sequencing reads to quality-controlled matrices and validated biomarker studies.
description: GoliathOmics coordinates configurable genomics workflows, bringing sample preparation, two-stage quality control, biomarker discovery, and execution management into one application. Teams can start with a focused SamplePrep workflow—processing paired FASTQ reads through alignment, automated QC guardrails, optional cfDNA fragmentomics, and methylation extraction into analysis-ready HDF5 matrices—without adopting the broader application platform all at once. When studies expand, process packs and staged validation pipelines support methylation, RNA-seq, and proteomics cohorts from exploratory research through regulated clinical (SaMD) lifecycles on GoliathApp.

features.title: SamplePrep workflow (FASTQ to analysis-ready HDF5)
features.description: Processes paired FASTQ files through download, configurable alignment, alignment QC with automated trim-and-realign remediation, optional cfDNA fragmentomics, methylation extraction, extraction QC, archiving, and cleanup—delivering clean chromosome methylation matrices and QC reports for downstream analysis.

features.title: Two-stage QC guardrails with per-sample overlays
features.description: Runs apply an established study QC configuration baked at instance start, with explicit per-sample guardrail overrides where a sample requires them—catching poor alignments or low-coverage extractions before they waste compute or corrupt cohort results.

features.title: Four alignment paths matched to study and hardware needs
features.description: Supports linear GPU (Clara Parabricks), linear GPU/CPU (GoliathAlign), stock pangenome (Giraffe), and bisulfite-aware WGBS pangenome (methylGrapher) under one consistent workflow and QC contract.

features.title: Worker-local BAM processing and automatic cleanup
features.description: Keeps large intermediate alignment files (BAMs and staged FASTQs) on the assigned worker's local scratch storage (METHYL_LOCAL_TMP) from alignment through extraction and deletion, avoiding shared-storage bottlenecks and publishing only compact final matrices and QC JSONs.

features.title: Process packs for analytes, library protocols, and cohorts
features.description: Pre-configured packs tailor parameters, reference assets, and QC thresholds to the sample matrix (buffy coat, cfDNA, tissue, plant tissue), library protocol (linear WGBS, pangenome WGBS, epi-GBS, targeted EM-seq), and disease or trait study across methylation, RNA-seq, and proteomics.

features.title: Database-compiled workflows for reproducible, auditable runs
features.description: Compiles DomainProgram workflow definitions into PostgreSQL nodes and freezes resolved configuration context at instance start, giving bioinformatics and regulatory teams an inspectable record of every sample run.

features.title: Platform operations: release profiles and worker enrollment
features.description: Packages validated workflow bundles and manages authenticated worker gateway sessions (POST /v1/workers/session) and typed ActionSpec catalogs so IT teams can deploy repeatable releases and scale distributed GPU/CPU workers.

features.title: Platform tenancy and clinical data integration (R2–R5)
features.description: Provides organization-scoped customer tenancy (portal.Organizations), Meta-backed clinical domain synchronization (OmicsCustomer, OmicsDisease, OmicsPatient, OmicsSample, OmicsLabBatch), and shared lab reagent inventory tracking for full platform deployments.
